mainEntity.name: What is the LEO Section at Rajadamnern Stadium?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Rajadamnern LEO Section is Section 10, main-arena seating that faces the front of the ring at exactly the same elevation as Club Class. It has 300 unassigned seats, in-section food and drink service, and the strongest local atmosphere in the stadium. Tickets are 1,500 THB.

mainEntity.name: Is LEO Section the same as Section 10?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. LEO Section and Section 10 are the same section. Rajadamnern Stadium numbers its sections, and LEO is the name used for Section 10.

mainEntity.name: Was the LEO Section called Second Class?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Older guides and some ticket listings call Section 10 Second Class, 2nd Class, LEO Second Class or LEO Class. They all mean the same section. LEO Section is the current name.
No. LEO is unassigned seating. You pick your position within Section 10 when you arrive, and you can move to another free position during the event.

mainEntity.name: Do I have to stand in LEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Every LEO ticket guarantees a seat. LEO is concrete bench seating with strict control of ticket numbers, and there is no standing area.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to arrive early to get a seat in LEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your seat is guaranteed whenever you arrive. Arriving when doors open, one hour before the first bout, gives you the widest choice of position, including front row.

mainEntity.name: Is LEO the same level as Club Class?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. LEO has exactly the same elevation and the same number of rows as Club Class. LEO faces the front of the ring, while Club Class looks towards the sides.

mainEntity.name: What view do you get from LEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: A front-facing view across the whole ring from an elevated position, with the blue corner directly in front of the section. The camera gantry and commentary team are positioned in LEO.

mainEntity.name: Which rows are best in LEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: MuayTix recommends around Row D and above for the fullest elevated view. Front row gives a closer, almost eye-level view of the ring. Both are good positions.

On Wednesday New Power, Thursday Petchyindee and Sunday Kiatpetch, the local legal betting crowd gathers in LEO and creates a high-energy atmosphere. On other nights LEO is simply the section local Muay Thai fans prefer.

mainEntity.name: Do I have to take part in betting?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. You sit alongside the atmosphere and watch the fight. Nobody expects you to take part.

mainEntity.name: Is free-flow beer included in LEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only on Saturday RWS Rajadamnern World Series events, when free-flow beer is included with the LEO ticket at the normal 1,500 THB price. On other nights, servers bring drinks to the section and you pay as you order.

mainEntity.name: Is LEO suitable for children and families?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. There is no age restriction, and the open bench seating lets families and groups sit together wherever they like.
